key_insight: MaRDI Open Interfaces improves interoperability in numerical optimization by standardizing solver access, reducing the effort needed to bind, swap, and benchmark optimization solvers across computational experiments.
engineering_relevance: The package helps computational scientists integrate nonlinear optimization solvers more efficiently, making it easier to prototype and compare methods in workflows such as training physics-informed neural networks.
method: Provides updated open interfaces for numerical optimization solvers
Abstracts solver-specific bindings to reduce code adaptation effort
Supports computational experiments and benchmarking across different solvers
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a demonstrated nonlinear optimization interface and an application to training physics-informed neural networks for viscous Burgers' equation, but does not provide quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Interoperability still depends on the quality and completeness of each solver’s interface implementation, so integration effort may remain nontrivial for new or unusual solvers.
paper_title: Software package MaRDI Open Interfaces for improved interoperability in numerical optimization
